opis: The meadow by the lake from the reference picture, now in the EVENING before a storm: dark blue-grey storm clouds, slanting rain, ONE bright zigzag LIGHTNING bolt over the lake lighting everything up. In the front a wicker BASKET has tipped over on the wet grass and a small fluffy YELLOW DUCKLING has just leapt OUT of it in fright - in mid-air, wings up, beak open, little drops flying - running towards a row of round green BUSHES on the right. The small HEDGEHOG, the BEAVER and the ROE DEER stand on the left in the rain, startled, reaching out after the duckling. Dramatic but not scary for a small child: a gust, a flash, a surprise.
